problem: Emma has 3 apples. She buys 5 more apples. How many apples does she have now?
Liam has 20 marbles. He gives 5 to his friend and then finds 8 more marbles. How many marbles does Liam have now?

A bakery sells cupcakes for $2 each and cookies for $3 each. If Sarah buys 4 cupcakes and 5 cookies, then spends an additional $10 on other treats, how much did she spend in total? How many items did she buy?
Samantha sold 5 cookies for $2 each. How much money did she make in total?
A school fundraiser sold 20 boxes of chocolates for $5 each and 15 bags of popcorn for $3 each. How much money did they raise in total?
During a bake sale, Lisa sold 12 cakes for $15 each, 30 cupcakes for $3 each, and 10 loaves of bread for $8 each. If she had to spend $50 on ingredients, how much profit did she make?
Lily has 3 apples. She buys 2 more apples. How many apples does she have now?
Tom has 10 marbles. He gives 3 marbles to his friend and then finds 5 more marbles. How many marbles does Tom have now?

Emily has a collection of 25 stamps. She decides to give 7 stamps to her brother and then buys 15 more stamps. Later, she finds 5 stamps in her drawer. If she wants to give away half of her total stamps now, how many will she give away?
Emma has 1/2 of a pizza left. She eats 1/4 of it. How much of the pizza does she have now?
Liam has 3/4 of a chocolate bar. He gives 1/2 of what he has to his friend. How much of the chocolate bar does Liam have left?

A recipe requires 2/3 cup of sugar. If you want to make 3 batches of the recipe, but you only have 1/2 cup of sugar, how much more sugar do you need to buy? First, calculate the total sugar needed, then subtract what you have.
Emily earns $15 for each hour she babysits. How much does she earn for 2 hours?
Jake works at a grocery store and earns $12 per hour. If he works 3 hours on Saturday and 4 hours on Sunday, how much money does he earn in total over the weekend?

Sophia has a part-time job where she earns $10 per hour. She works 5 hours on Monday, 6 hours on Wednesday, and 4 hours on Friday. If she also worked 3 extra hours during the weekend at the same rate, how much does she earn in total for the week?
You watched a movie that lasted 90 minutes. How many hours did you spend watching the movie?
If you have a soccer practice that lasts 150 minutes and a basketball practice that lasts 120 minutes, how many hours do you spend in total on both practices?

You have three activities planned for the weekend. The first activity is a hike that lasts 180 minutes. The second activity is a picnic that lasts 240 minutes. The third activity is a movie that lasts 120 minutes. How many hours do you spend on all three activities combined?
You have 4 packs of stickers. Each pack contains 5 stickers. How many stickers do you have in total?
A farmer has 6 rows of apple trees. Each row has 8 apple trees. If he harvests 3 apples from each tree, how many apples does he harvest in total?

Sarah is organizing a school event. She needs to buy 12 boxes of cupcakes. Each box contains 15 cupcakes. She also wants to buy 10 boxes of cookies, with each box containing 20 cookies. If she plans to serve 3 cupcakes and 2 cookies per student and expects 30 students, how many extra cupcakes and cookies will she have after the event?
Samantha wants to buy a toy that costs $5. How much money does she need?
Tom is saving for a video game that costs $30. He has saved $10 so far. How much more money does he need to reach his goal?

Lily wants to buy a new bicycle for $150. She has $50 saved. She plans to save $20 each week. How many weeks will it take her to save enough money to buy the bicycle? What is the total amount of money she will have after those weeks?
Your mom gives you $5 for helping with chores. How much money do you have now?
You receive $10 from your dad and $15 from your mom for your birthday. If you spend $5 on a toy, how much money do you have left?

You ask your parents for money to save for a new bike. Your dad gives you $20, your mom gives you $30, and your grandparents give you $50. You want to buy a bike that costs $100. After saving for two weeks, your parents give you an additional $10 each week. How much more money do you need to reach your goal?
Your grandparents gave you $10 for your birthday. How much money do you have now?
Your grandparents gave you $15 for your birthday and $5 for your good grades. How much money did they give you in total?

For your birthday, your grandparents gave you $20. Then, for Christmas, they sent you $30. A week later, they sent you $50 more just because. If you spend $15 on a toy and save the rest, how much money do you have left?
You want to buy a toy that costs $10. You have $4. How much more money do you need?
Emma is saving money to buy a bike that costs $150. She has saved $60 so far. If she saves $15 each week, how many more weeks will it take her to have enough money?

A school is raising money to buy new computers that cost $1,200. They have already raised $450 from a bake sale and $200 from a car wash. If they plan to hold a raffle and expect to make $300 from it, how much more money do they need to raise after the raffle?
Emily read 15 pages of her book on Monday and 10 pages on Tuesday. How many pages did she read in total?

Tom read 20 pages of a novel on Wednesday and 35 pages on Thursday. On Friday, he decided to read twice as many pages as he did on Wednesday. How many pages did Tom read in total over these three days?

Sarah is keeping track of her reading. In the first week, she read 25 pages on Monday, 30 pages on Tuesday, and 20 pages on Wednesday. On Thursday, she read twice the number of pages she read on Tuesday. On Friday, she had a reading marathon and read 50 pages. In the second week, she read 40 pages on Saturday and 60 pages on Sunday. How many pages did Sarah read in total over the two weeks?
Emma has a book with 50 pages. She has read 20 pages. How many pages does she have left to read?
Liam has a notebook with 120 pages. He wrote in it for 3 days, using 25 pages on the first day, 15 on the second, and 20 on the third. How many pages are left in the notebook?

Sophia has 250 pages in her study book. She plans to read 30 pages a day. After reading for 5 days, she decides to take a break and reads 15 pages on the weekend. If she continues this pattern for 4 weeks, how many pages will be left in the book?
If a book has 3 pages and you need to print 4 copies of it, how many pages will you print in total?
A magazine has 20 pages. If you want to buy 5 magazines, how many pages will you have in total? If you read 15 pages from each magazine, how many pages will you have left?

A school is printing a new textbook that has 150 pages. They plan to print 8 copies for each of the 5 classes. If each class has 4 students, how many pages will be printed in total? After distributing the textbooks, if each student reads 10 pages, how many pages will remain un-read across all classes?
Emma reads 5 pages of her book every day. If she continues this pace, how many pages will she read in 4 days?
Liam has a reading goal of finishing 120 pages in 10 days. If he has already read 30 pages, how many pages does he need to read each day for the remaining days to reach his goal?

Sofia plans to read a total of 300 pages over the next 15 days. In the first week, she reads 50 pages, and in the second week, she reads 70 pages. How many pages does she need to read each day for the remaining days to reach her goal?
Sarah wrote 10 pages in her notebook on Monday and 5 pages on Tuesday. How many pages did she write in total?
Tom is writing a book. He wrote 20 pages in the first week and 15 pages in the second week. If he plans to write 10 pages each week for the next 3 weeks, how many pages will he have written in total?

Emily is working on a project that requires her to write pages every day. She wrote 12 pages on Monday, 8 pages on Tuesday, and 15 pages on Wednesday. For the next 4 days, she plans to write 10 pages each day. If she takes a break on the weekend and does not write any pages, how many total pages will she have written by the end of the week?
If you have 52 weeks, how many years is that?
Sarah saved for 90 weeks to buy a new bike. How many years did she save?

James is training for a marathon. He has been training for 104 weeks. If he starts training for another 78 weeks, how many total years will he have been training by the end of that period? Also, how many years is that if he takes a break of 26 weeks in between?
Sarah is writing her name on 3 pieces of paper. Each time, she writes 'Sarah'. How many times does she write her name in total?

Tom is making friendship bracelets. He uses a pattern of red, blue, and green beads. If he makes 5 bracelets and uses the same pattern for each, how many beads does he use if each bracelet requires 6 beads?

In a class project, each student needs to write a story with a repeating structure: Introduction, Conflict, Resolution. If there are 12 students in the class and each student writes 3 drafts of their story before the final version, how many times do they write the sections of Introduction, Conflict, and Resolution in total, if each section is written in each draft?
A toy originally costs $20. If the price is increased by 10%, what is the new price of the toy?
A book costs $15. If the price increases by 20% and then by another 10%, what is the final price of the book?

A bicycle costs $200. If the price increases by 15% in the first year and then by another 25% in the second year, what is the final price of the bicycle? Additionally, if the seller offers a discount of 10% on this final price, what will you pay for the bicycle after the discount?
Lily has 1/2 of a chocolate bar. If she eats 1/4 of it, how much of the chocolate bar does she have left?
Tom has a pizza cut into 8 equal slices. He eats 3/8 of the pizza and his friend eats 2/8. How many slices are left?

A recipe requires 3/4 of a cup of sugar for 2 servings. If Sarah wants to make 6 servings, how much sugar will she need in total? First, find out how much sugar is needed for 1 serving, then multiply by 6. If she only has 2 cups of sugar, will she have enough? If not, how much more sugar does she need?
Sophie has 4 apples. She buys 3 more. How many apples does she have now?
Tom has 10 marbles. He gives 3 marbles to his friend and then finds 5 more marbles on the ground. How many marbles does Tom have now?
A store sells pencils for $2 each and erasers for $1 each. Emma buys 5 pencils and 3 erasers. Later, she returns 2 pencils and buys 1 more eraser. How much money did Emma spend in total?
Emma has 3 apples. She buys 2 more apples from the store. How many apples does Emma have now?
Tom has 5 toy cars. He gives 2 to his friend and then buys 4 more. How many toy cars does Tom have now?

A school is organizing a field trip. They have 20 students signed up. Each student needs to pay $10 for the trip. If 5 more students join, what will be the total cost for all students? If the school has $150 already collected, how much more money do they need?
If one pizza has 8 slices, how many slices are there in 2 pizzas?
You order 3 pizzas for a party. Each pizza has 8 slices. If 10 slices are eaten, how many slices are left?

You are having a pizza party with 4 friends. You order 5 pizzas. Each pizza has 10 slices. If each person eats 2 slices and you want to save 3 slices for later, how many slices will be left over after everyone has eaten?
If each apple costs $2 and you buy 3 apples, how much do you spend?
You are organizing a party and need to buy 5 packs of balloons. Each pack contains 8 balloons. If each balloon costs $1, how much do you spend on balloons in total?

A school is planning a field trip and needs to buy tickets for 4 classes. Each class has 25 students. A ticket for each student costs $10. If they also need to rent a bus that costs $150, what is the total cost for the tickets and the bus rental?
Mia has 3 apples and her friend gives her 2 more. How many apples does Mia have now?
Tom has 4 toy cars, 3 action figures, and 5 building blocks. How many toys does Tom have in total?

A bakery sold 24 cupcakes on Monday, 18 cupcakes on Tuesday, 30 cupcakes on Wednesday, and 22 cupcakes on Thursday. If they sold 15 cupcakes on Friday, how many cupcakes did the bakery sell in total from Monday to Friday?
Tom has 3 apples. He buys 2 more apples from the store. How many apples does Tom have now?
Lily is making a fruit salad. She has 4 bananas, 3 oranges, and 2 apples. If she uses 1 banana and 1 orange, how many pieces of fruit does she have left?

A school is organizing a field trip. They have 120 students and 15 chaperones. Each bus can hold 10 people. If each bus is filled to capacity, how many buses are needed? After that, if they find they need 2 more chaperones to go, how many total people will be going on the trip?
A bag of apples weighs 3 pounds. If you buy 2 bags, how much do the apples weigh in total?
A box contains 5 books that each weigh 1.5 pounds. If you add 2 more books that weigh 2 pounds each, what is the total weight of the box?

A shipment includes 3 pallets of oranges. Each pallet weighs 50 pounds. There are 4 boxes on each pallet, and each box weighs 5 pounds. If you also include 10 bags of sugar, each weighing 2 pounds, what is the total weight of the shipment?
Lily weighs 50 pounds. After a week, she loses 2 pounds. How much does she weigh now?
Tom started at 160 pounds. He lost 5 pounds in the first week and gained 3 pounds in the second week. What is his weight now?

Sarah weighs 135 pounds. Over the next 4 weeks, she loses 4 pounds in the first week, gains 2 pounds in the second week, loses 3 pounds in the third week, and gains 1 pound in the fourth week. How much does she weigh now? After that, if she plans to lose 5 more pounds, what will her weight be then?
You have 3 apples. If you buy 2 more apples, how many apples do you have in total?
A box has 4 rows of chocolates with 6 chocolates in each row. If you eat 5 chocolates, how many chocolates are left in the box?
Liam has 5 packs of stickers. Each pack contains 8 stickers. He gives 10 stickers to his friend and then buys 3 more packs. How many stickers does Liam have now?
Lily has 5 apples. She buys 3 more apples. How many apples does she have now?
Tom has 12 marbles. He gives 4 marbles to his friend and then finds 6 more marbles. How many marbles does Tom have now?

A school is organizing a field trip. They have 60 students and need to divide them into groups of 5. After forming the groups, 3 students decide not to go. How many groups will there be, and how many students will be left?
Samantha has $20 to spend on snacks. She buys a bag of chips for $3. How much money does she have left?
James has a budget of $50 for a school project. He spends $15 on materials and $10 on decorations. If he wants to buy a poster for $8, how much money will he have left?

Lucy has a total budget of $100 for her birthday party. She wants to spend $40 on food, $25 on games, and $15 on decorations. If she also wants to invite 5 friends and buy each of them a small gift for $5, how much money will she have left after all her expenses?
Emily bought a sandwich for $5 and a drink for $2. How much did she spend in total?
Michael went to the store and bought 3 packs of gum for $1 each and a chocolate bar for $2. How much did he spend in total?

Lily went shopping for school supplies. She bought 4 notebooks for $3 each, 2 packs of pencils for $2 each, and a backpack for $15. How much did she spend in total? After shopping, she used a coupon that gave her 10% off her total purchase. What is the final amount she spent after using the coupon?
You have $20 to spend on snacks. You buy a bag of chips for $5. How much money do you have left?
You have a budget of $50 for a party. You buy decorations for $20 and snacks for $15. How much money do you have left for drinks?
You have a monthly budget of $200. You spend $45 on groceries, $30 on gas, and $25 on a new shirt. If you also want to save $50 this month, how much money can you spend on entertainment?
Sara has 5 apples. She buys some more apples to have a total of 8 apples. How many apples did she buy?
Tom has $20. He spends some money on a toy that costs $12. How much money does he have left?

A school is organizing a field trip. They need to collect $150 for the trip. If 10 students each contribute $5, how much more money do they need to collect? If 5 more students join, how much will each student need to contribute to meet the goal?
Sarah worked for 3 hours on Monday and 2 hours on Tuesday. How many hours did she work in total?
Tom worked 5 hours on Wednesday, 4 hours on Thursday, and 3 hours on Friday. How many hours did he work in total this week?

Emily has a part-time job where she works 6 hours on Saturday and 8 hours on Sunday. During the week, she works 5 hours each on Monday and Tuesday, and 4 hours on Wednesday. How many total hours did she work over the entire week?
Sarah worked 5 hours of overtime this week. If her overtime pay rate is $15 per hour, how much will she earn for her overtime work?
James worked 10 hours of overtime this week. His regular hourly wage is $20. Calculate his total pay for the week, including overtime pay, if overtime is paid at 1.5 times his regular rate.

Emily is a nurse who works 40 hours a week at $25 per hour. This week, she worked an additional 15 hours of overtime. Calculate her total earnings for the week, including overtime pay, and determine how much more she earned compared to a week with no overtime.
Emily earns $50 each week for babysitting. How much does she earn in one week?
James works part-time at a grocery store and earns $15 per hour. If he works 5 hours on Saturday and 3 hours on Sunday, how much does he earn in total for the weekend?

Lily has two jobs. She earns $20 per hour at her tutoring job and works 10 hours a week. At her dog walking job, she earns $12 per hour and works 15 hours a week. How much does she earn in total each week from both jobs? If she spends $50 weekly on transportation, what is her net earning for the week?
